title: Companion Objects knowledge check

questions.prompt: Which statement best captures the main idea of “Companion Objects”?
options: It removes the need to understand types or runtime behavior.
Classes group state and behavior; primary constructors and properties keep ordinary domain models concise, while initialization order still matters.

questions.answer_key: Classes group state and behavior; primary constructors and properties keep ordinary domain models concise, while initialization order still matters.
questions.explanation: The reliable answer is grounded in the lesson’s main principle: Classes group state and behavior; primary constructors and properties keep ordinary domain models concise, while initialization order still matters. Ignore warnings and suppress failures before identifying the cause.

questions.answer_key: Use a minimal reproducible example, compare the actual result with the expected result, and check the target/version assumptions.
